study.question: Can target-field stratification before local activation preserve predictive information at 20 summary positions, compared with full100 scoring and equally sized target-independent compression?
study.hypothesis: Observed code limitation: DIN materializes [B,100,4*key_width] interactions and runs its nonlinear scorer at every padded history position, before pooling. The receipt reports 297.24s training, 25.82s validation inference and 4.197GB peak allocation, but does not identify the dominant cost or prove redundant histories. In ten contiguous blocks of ten, separate events matching the nonzero target category OR brand from the complement, average all item/action embeddings within each stratum, and apply the SAME local scorer to these20 summaries. Multiplying summary scores by occupancy preserves multiplicity of unnormalized pooling. The conditional hypothesis is that reduced within-slot relevance heterogeneity limits compression bias better than ordinary means, while reducing scorer cost. No local evidence yet establishes information loss, semantic routing benefit, or speedup.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit target-dependent local activation, concatenated item fields and weighted-sum readout from the supplied four-task adaptation; compress BEFORE nonlinear scoring instead of activating all100 events. DIN already establishes target-aware summaries; no originality claim for target conditioning.

Pinned benchmark forward path projects the sequence and interacts it with unified field tokens through stacked layers. The benchmark section describes inner-Transformer local groups. Here use parameter-free target-field strata and count-corrected averages feeding the unchanged DIN scorer, without local Transformers or repeated unified layers. This is not a LONGER reproduction or an original-paper priority determination.

Section2.3 describes HeMix fixed/feature-conditioned queries and low-rank mixing; HiFormer post-pooling heterogeneous interaction. Here target conditioning sets discrete group membership before the scorer; no query bank, heterogeneous mixing or new token layers. Original HeMix/HiFormer/LONGER paper full texts are unavailable in this archive; broader novelty remains unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Only history representation before the baseline local activation changes. match20 uses ten contiguous blocks, two slots per block determined by exact nonzero category OR brand match with target. Every valid event enters exactly one slot; every item field and historical action is averaged with the same membership. Empty slots have zero mean and zero occupancy. No position beyond the fixed100 is read. rotated20 rotates the binary membership by floor(valid_count/2) among valid positions within each block, preserving each slot occupancy exactly while breaking most semantic alignment. uniform20 uses20 contiguous blocks of5 with one slot each; uniform10 uses10 blocks of10. All sources are standalone and all learned modules and parameter counts are identical to baseline. Baseline is not edited. Zero IDs are excluded from match evidence; other positive unknown codes cannot be identified from supplied metadata and remain a limitation.
predictions: Primary prospective contrast: match20 exceeds rotated20 click AUC under identical capacity, slot count and per-block slot occupancies. A positive single-seed difference is preliminary, not mechanism proof.

At20 slots, match20 should exceed uniform20 if semantic grouping helps more than finer contiguous grouping. uniform10 versus uniform20 measures ordinary compression resolution; differences cannot identify semantic routing alone.

For a useful quality-cost candidate, click AUC should be within0.001 absolute of baseline0.65554408 and model-only inference throughput at least1.2x baseline111204examples/s (predeclared practical targets, not significance thresholds). Full host wall time and allocation may improve much less because embedding lookup and loading remain unchanged.

Predeclared baseline history slices: empty,1-16,17-64,>64. The long-history slice has1401885 samples,50957 positives and1350928 negatives. Report counts and four-task AUC/logloss for all models; compare per-user paired intervals when host supports them. Semantic compression is predicted to help most versus rotated control in >64 histories; do not infer this from baseline cross-slice AUC differences.

Empty histories must yield exactly zero pooled histories, finite four-task outputs and gradients. Masked-event IDs and historical actions must not affect outputs for the same visible history. Constant scorer should recover the original masked sum up to numerical precision. These are required host correctness checks before substantive training, not completed checks here.
falsifiers: If match20 does not beat occupancy-matched rotated20 across feasible paired repetitions, the semantic routing claim is unsupported at this implementation and100-event limit.
If uniform20 matches or improves match20 at no greater measured cost, prefer the simpler compressor; semantic separation is not needed by this evidence.
If speedup is absent or click AUC declines by more than0.001, the declared quality-cost objective fails even if another metric improves.
If masking, empty-history, gradients or finite-probability host checks fail, stop that variant and preserve failure receipt; this is an implementation failure rather than scientific refutation.
alternative_explanations: Reduction in dense scorer operations is inferred from code, not a measured compute bottleneck; embedding, data loading and bmm overhead can dominate100-event inputs.

Dice uses BatchNorm over flattened summaries. Changing slot distributions and zero-slot proportion changes normalization even with identical parameters. The matched occupancy rotation control controls zero-slot proportion but not feature distributions. A later matched activation replacement experiment is needed if consequential.
Compression can regularize noisy histories. A gain over full DIN alone cannot establish semantic information preservation.

Rotation retains target-dependent occupancy and some accidental alignment; one-event blocks or uniform match blocks are unchanged. A null may reflect weak intervention or few matches. A subsequent host diagnostic of match frequency, changed-membership fraction and occupied-slot counts is necessary before abandoning the direction.

Exact category/brand match may miss cross-category interest; averaged item identifiers may erase rare useful events. Auxiliary labels are user/category/brand24h matches and may particularly favor these strata; auxiliary gains cannot substitute for click improvement.

No independent source-digest/data audit or fresh baseline execution is possible in this proposal jail. Baseline receipt and frozen protocol are inherited host evidence. Current local work verifies syntax and source contracts only; runtime behavior is unmeasured.
Any subset screening or single-seed outcome is exploratory. Full validation and paired seeds are required before repeated support; no causal inference from comparing baseline history-length slices.
